description: Names that are not names. The source carries text that identifies no object — a placeholder, a vandal edit, a batch import that left one string on dozens of unrelated things. A row under such a name is dropped by `seed fetch` (db/seed/cli.py) and the committed datasets are checked against this list by tests/test_seed_merge.py, so the same text cannot come back through a re-fetch unnoticed.
why_not_heuristic: A pattern (mixed script, repetition) was rejected: 204 names in the OSM sets are legitimately mixed-script (a Belarusian or Polish form beside the Russian one) and generic names like «Столовая» or «Часовня» are real. Judging those in code would drop good rows. A list with a reason per entry is reviewable and stays honest about being a judgement call.

names.name: Заўжды цікаVа
names.reason: Placeholder text («всегда интересно») written with Latin letters inside Belarusian words, carried by 61 cafés across the voblast — the same string on unrelated objects is a batch import or an edit, not a name.

names.name: Заўжды ЦiкаVa
names.reason: The same placeholder as «Заўжды цікаVа» in another capitalisation; listed separately because matching is on the normalised name, and the two differ in which letters are Latin.
